sentence: Randomly draws a turn order for everyone in the chat so each person takes a turn adding a song to a shared playlist, and tracks who has added theirs.
use_when: A group wants a fair random order for who adds songs to a shared playlist
Everyone adds one song per round and the group needs to see who is next
People want to tick off when they have added their song
Settling who goes first in any take-turns list for the chat
dont_use_when: Picking one winner or one person from the group, which needs a single random pick
Voting on songs or choosing between options, which needs a poll
Playing a game with moves and scores between players
